surfaces.says: Claude Code reads CLAUDE.md at the repository root as project instructions, and one sub-agent definition per Markdown file under .claude/agents/ -- YAML front-matter carrying name and description, the body as the agent's instructions. Taken from the product's documentation; a claim until a run of the product is observed reading what was served.

Codex reads AGENTS.md at the repository root as project instructions, and one agent definition per TOML file under .codex/agents/ -- name, description and developer_instructions as strings. Taken from the product's documentation; a claim until a run of the product is observed reading what was served.
